thread:
Nadia: Heads up  we need a short-run pricing experiment for the packaging page before launch. Focus: FAQ tweaks, tier names, and a tiny calculator that captures high-intent leads. Keep it lightweight.
Theo: Routing rule proposal: if est_monthly > $5k OR user checks 'Need contract', tag as sales. Else, enroll in webinar nurture.
Ivy: UX notes: two CTAs only  'Get tailored quote' and 'Run estimate'. Keep modal single-field for email when quote chosen.
Marco: Analytics snippet to push: 
```js
window.dataLayer.push({event:'mini_pricing_calc',value:est,plan:tier})
```
Sam: Copy for micro-FAQ (one-liners):
- "How we estimate"  Based on expected tokens and requests; we refine with your telemetry.
- "Reserved capacity?"  Choose Dedicated for committed throughput and SLA (subject to terms).
Nadia: Tier name options? Prefer distinct, product-y names.
Theo: My picks: ['Launch','Momentum','Command']  concise descriptors to follow.
Ivy: Add small tooltip: 'Why we ask for commit' linking to SLA docs. Show checkbox only if est >= $1k.
Marco: Webinar flow: auto-enroll est between $500k; >$5k triggers inline calendar invite option plus sales ping. Landing page should accept prefilled est param.
LegalBot: Reminder: any SLA mention must include "subject to standard terms" and link. Avoid absolute uptime claims.
EventBot: I'll wire the webinar enroll endpoint to accept ?est= & email=.
Nadia: Action items: Theo  finalize routing rules; Ivy  mock CTAs and tooltip; Marco  GTM snippet + BI mapping; Sam  final micro-FAQ; LegalBot  terms snippet. Due EOD Thu.
Ivy: I'll upload Figma frames and tag people.
Theo: Agree on timeline.
Nadia: If copy/design not frozen by Tue, we push launch one week. Thanks team :thumbsup:
